status: MEASURED scoped fresh-process build latency, compiler/runtime memory and Windows standalone comparison; no unrestricted superiority claim

plan.cold_build: Fresh required tool processes, source file through complete standalone executable on disk; native BBC frontend and native XAX importer; unchanged generic XAX verification, graph binding and lowerers. Awib native translator then optimized C compilation/link; brainfry native AOT. BBC uses its required unchanged generic Python bootstrap backend; Awib uses a native generic command/file sequencer, and brainfry launches its native AOT compiler directly. No shared Python wrapper is imposed on competitors; no overhead subtraction. All compiler children run detached with explicit stdio handles to avoid extra console allocation. Compiler construction and SDK install excluded. OS/file caches warm after warmups. Deployment and APK signing excluded.
plan.build_trials: Three separate collector processes/runs; ten fresh timing builds per arm/source/target/run, one warmup each. Memory profiling separate: four builds per arm/source/target/run (12 per case); no profiled elapsed times scored.
plan.ordering: For each case, all six arm permutations repeated five times and deterministically shuffled for 30 timing rounds; twice for twelve memory rounds. Case order shuffled per run; no simultaneous benchmark jobs.
plan.windows_process: Fresh detached process, inherited binary stdin file and stdout pipe; QPC around CreateProcess, output consumption and wait, excluding input/pipe preparation and oracle checks. 30 trials per compiler/source, three runs, two warmups per arm/source/run. All output/status checked.
plan.windows_ram: Runtime: kernel lifetime PeakWorkingSetSize queried on retained process handle after exit, no sampler in timing runs. Separate job-mode trials also record kernel PeakJobMemoryUsed (commit) and approximately 1 ms simultaneous working-set sum over all live job PIDs. Compiler RAM uses full job tree: exact peak commit and sampled simultaneous working set; shared resident pages counted once per process, so can double-count shared DLLs; not PSS. Actual sampling gaps and missed queries retained.
plan.android_ram: Separate on-device native resource collector uses wait4 for each exec child and ru_maxrss in KiB. Single-process runtime peak RSS only, includes shared mappings; not PSS. No compiler runs on Android. Thirty samples per arm/source, three batches; every output and exit validated. Collector self peak RSS is retained as a diagnostic. Launch/fork/exec costs belong to the child lifetime; values close to a launch floor cannot isolate program-only resident memory.
limits: Pinned source configurations only; twelve existing workloads and holdouts, no new twenty-workload/real-app/best-mode claim.

Windows Awib now Clang 19 -O3 unsigned-char with MSVC 14.44 linker/static CRT and separately linked binary-stdio adapter; earlier GCC pilot kept separate. Awib compiler rebuilt using existing polyglot route.

Windows BBC wrapper uses verified checked byte copies and unchanged generic graph-splice lowering views to avoid Win64 five-argument borrowed-return fallback; build cost included. No production Python backend modified.
CPU clocks, affinity and thermals not controlled; no parity/victory claim from sampled memory.

excluded_calibration.reason: External Python coordinator imposed on native competitors and created extra console processes. Excluded before inspecting competitive aggregates; replaced by detached native command sequencing and direct brainfry invocation. Partial completed samples and original plan retained.

plan.windows_awib_configuration: Pinned Awib native translator rebuilt by Clang 19 -O3; generated Windows C uses Clang 19 -O3 -funsigned-char -Dmain=wrapped_main and the generic precompiled binary_stdio.obj, linked by MSVC 14.44 with static CRT and /Brepro. Translator compiler has 16 MiB reserved stack; target programs use default linker reserve. Translation, compilation and linking all timed.

environment.clang: Android (13624864, based on r530567e) clang version 19.0.1 (https://android.googlesource.com/toolchain/llvm-project 97a699bf4812a18fb657c2779f5296a4ab2694d2)
environment.controls: Serial benchmarks; no fixed CPU clocks, affinity or thermal control. Ordinary Windows background services remain. File and OS caches warmed. Detached native launch with explicit inherited binary handles; no created console.

analysis_plan.estimand: For each compiler/case, median over pooled trials; arithmetic mean of twelve case medians. Differences are comparator minus BBC in milliseconds or MiB. Workloads/holdouts fixed; no exclusions selected from measured values.
analysis_plan.intervals: Exploratory paired hierarchical bootstrap, 5000 resamples with fixed seed 20261020. Resample three run clusters, twelve workload indices and within-run paired trial rounds. Bonferroni family of eighteen comparisons; two-sided confidence level 1 - 0.05/18. Three run clusters limit inference; no unrestricted superiority/parity claim.
analysis_plan.case_spread: Per-case median, first and third quartiles retained; worst absolute BBC time/memory difference retained.
analysis_plan.memory_caveats: Sampled compiler resident sum is a lower bound to peak simultaneous RSS, shared DLL pages counted per process; commit is a distinct kernel peak metric. Intervals do not repair sampling bias. Android child lifetime includes process creation and shared resident pages; not PSS or code-only memory.
analysis_plan.artifact_bytes: One deterministic complete executable per compiler/target/program; range and arithmetic mean reported independently from RAM.
analysis_plan.infra_failure: First attempted runtime run 2 stopped before samples because ADB daemon had restarted and no device was yet enumerated; automatic wireless discovery recovered without intervention. No scored sample excluded.

memory_sampling.policy: Shared resident pages counted once per live process; approximately 1 ms high-resolution waitable timer. Sampled sum is a lower bound to peak simultaneous tree RSS; exited short-lived descendants can be missed. Job peak commit is a distinct kernel lifetime maximum. No PSS/parity inference.

windows.description: Concurrent parent 64 MiB plus child 32 MiB touched allocations; excluded from scores. Exact job commit and sampled simultaneous resident sum must exceed 96 MiB.

android.description: External 16 MiB touched-allocation control, excluded from scores. wait4 ru_maxrss must exceed 16384 KiB. Child lifetime includes fork/exec startup; no PSS claim.

limitations: Pinned source configurations only; twelve existing workloads and holdouts, no new twenty-workload/real-app/best-mode claim.

Windows Awib now Clang 19 -O3 unsigned-char with MSVC 14.44 linker/static CRT and separately linked binary-stdio adapter; earlier GCC pilot kept separate. Awib compiler rebuilt using existing polyglot route.

Windows BBC wrapper uses verified checked byte copies and unchanged generic graph-splice lowering views to avoid Win64 five-argument borrowed-return fallback; build cost included. No production Python backend modified.
CPU clocks, affinity and thermals not controlled; no parity/victory claim from sampled memory.
Runtime and compiler memory are scoped to the common safe subset and exact configurations. Runtime measures process launch with I/O, not sustained calls or real apps.

Compiler RSS is sampled and can miss peaks; shared mappings can be counted across processes. Kernel commit is not resident memory. Android RSS and Windows working-set accounting are different OS metrics.
Only three run clusters and 5000 bootstrap resamples; far-tail family-adjusted intervals are exploratory and cannot establish unrestricted wins or RAM parity.
Routine desktop/development activity and background services were not isolated; no idle-machine, fixed-clocks or thermal-control claim. All benchmark jobs ran serially.
External collector sources are local hash-pinned tools, not BBC/XAX implementation; public runner distribution remains incomplete.

BBC prototype build coordinator allocates and retains initialized ctypes ABI buffers, including the 64 MiB importer workspace, through its build function. Results measure that actual lifetime policy, not a minimum memory requirement.

Builds use native BBC filtering and native XAX import, followed by unchanged generic Python verification, binding and lowering on Windows. This is not a native XAX compiler-host or Android-hosted build claim.
